passages.text:
Re: A/AID meeting readout Meta President of Global Affairs
[contact omitted] USAID Press Monday, June 17, 2024 at 3:22:15PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Chioma Ayogu
Cc: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem, [contact omitted] Kayden McKenzie, [contact omitted] Benjamin
Thompson, [contact omitted] DRG Bureau Taskers, [contact omitted] Elena Johnston,
[contact omitted] Jessica Benton Cooney, [contact omitted] Katherine Morgan, [contact omitted] Shannon
Maguire, [contact omitted] Siham Nurhussein, [contact omitted] Tamara Boorstein, [contact omitted]
eecomms
Thanks all, we are not doing a readout for this one.
Thanks,
Spencer
On Fri, Jun 14, 2024 at 1:14 PM Chioma Ayogu <[contact omitted]> wrote:
GC would have concerns about a readout due to Hill sensitivities and the ongoing Supreme Court litigation related to
communications with social media companies. This engagement falls on the correct side of the line, but a press readout
would invite inquiries and scrutiny from a number of places.
Best,
Chioma
CHIOMA AYOGU
Senior Counsel
Office of the General Counsel, Development, Democracy and Economics (GC/DDE)
Clients: DRG Bureau
[contact omitted]
Phone: [opaque block]
U.S. Agency for International Development
1300 Pennsylvania Ave., NW, Washington, DC 20523
On Fri, Jun 14, 2024 at 1:11 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
| leave this to GC, but let me also confirm.
Vera Zakem
Chief Digital Democracy and Rights Officer
Bureau for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
USAID
[contact omitted]
On Fri, Jun 14, 2024 at 10:09 AM Kayden McKenzie <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Looping in some additional folks to provide more context and for awareness/tracking.
+Vera Zakem +Shannon Maguire +Chioma Ayogu +Siham Nurhussein
Thanks,
Kayden
On Fri, Jun 14, 2024 at 1:01 PM USAID Press <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Kayden, is there a reason in particular? We've readout similar high level meetings like this recently.
Thanks,
Spencer
On Fri, Jun 14, 2024 at 12:09 PM Kayden McKenzie <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Spencer.
Checked with our technical experts in the Bureau, and they flagged that there should be no public
amplification of this meeting.

Can you confirm that we will not be doing a readout?
Best,
Kayden
On Fri, Jun 14, 2024 at 11:19 AM USAID Press <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey all, apologies, EE own this meeting.
Can you all draft this readout by eod?
Thanks!
Spencer
On Jun 14, 2024, at 10:44 AM, Jessica Benton Cooney <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sure - will do.
Hey al, co4id yo4 dratdand cie ara rea pousfo r tressdmusaidrators meeting with Meta's
President of Global Affairs by end of day?
Thanks, (
Spencer
USAID I Office of Press Relations
[contact omitted]
--
Jessica Benton Cooney I Senior Communications and Outreach
Specialist, USAID/DRG
Bureau for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
